sphere_commentary.overview:
Across the library the data suggest consistent positive outcomes with notable series‑level patterns.
• HEALING shows the highest sample size and tightest variance, indicating reliable entrainment.
• THRIVING matches HEALING mean but exhibits the strongest protocol‑level peaks, especially in Focus.
• TRANSFORMING trails in mean and displays the widest spread, matching its low‑affect design intent.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
Series comparison highlights distinct efficacy signatures aligned with design intent.
• HEALING delivers steady regulation; crisis protocols sit ~0.5 points below series mean, which is structurally expected.
• THRIVING achieves the highest observed means, with a clear level‑gradient (L3 > L2 > L1) in Creative Flow and Focus.
• TRANSFORMING shows the lowest mean and highest variance, with several ASCENT protocols showing bimodal or low‑mean signals.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
A handful of protocols display distributional or predictive mismatches meriting deeper probing.
• T-FC-L3 (Summit) shows a bimodal score pattern with a high‑score tail, suggesting a population split.
• X-MC-L3 (Cosmos) has a low mean (5.7) and high std (2.45) yet qualitative reports of noticeable improvement.
• H-CR-L2 predicted 7.96 by AutoGluon versus observed 6.52, indicating a model‑data divergence.
• Multiple protocols (e.g., X-MD-L3, H-SL-L1) exhibit strong cross‑run drift (sim < 0.7), hinting at evolving analytical framing.
• YouTube reach is uniformly low; high outcome scores like H-OS-L1 (30 views) contrast with minimal discovery signals.
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Protocol‑level signals point to actionable design refinements and investigative priorities.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] T-FC-L1 (Compass) – rhythm perceived as “slightly busy”; consider a calmer rhythm variant.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] X-MD-L1 & X-MD-L2 – motivation ASCENT arc underperforms; test steeper ascent or shorter hold.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] X-MC-L3 – low mean/high variance; launch targeted recruitment and evaluate a revised DESCENT gradient.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] H-CR-L* – AutoGluon overpredicts; explore adjusting crisis‑specific outcome framing.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] H-OS-L1 – strong efficacy with modest YouTube reach; boost promotion to increase discovery.
• [SINGLE SOURCE] T-MB-L3 (Orbit) – “Did NOT settle” reports; experiment with extended ease‑in before hold phase.
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Embedding drift is pervasive, but cluster analysis is unavailable.
• CROSS‑RUN DRIFT: All 30 protocols show notable drift (similarity < 0.85); highest drift in X-MD-L3 (0.507).
• CROSS‑PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: Insufficient embeddings for reliable clustering.
• Confidence: Drift likely reflects analytic maturation as data accumulate rather than isolated instability.
